langCode.description: Language of this message file (used for <html lang>).

extDescription.message: Local password manager: fills logins from your Keystead desktop app – no cloud, everything stays on this computer.

csNoMatches.message: No matching logins for this page.

csNoFields.message: No login form found on this page.

csNoFieldsSignup.message: There is only a sign-up form here. To fill a saved login anyway, pick it in the Keystead popup.

csNoField.message: Click into the field that should receive the password first.

csFillFailed.message: The login could not be filled.

csGenerateOutdated.message: Your generator settings in the Keystead popup need a newer Keystead app. Update the app or reset the settings in the popup.

csNotConnected.message: Keystead is not connected. Open the extension to set up the connection.

csInsecureWarning.message: Warning: this page is not encrypted (http).

csInsecureBlocked.message: Not filled: this page is not encrypted (http), but the login is stored for https.

csNeverDone.message: Keystead won't ask on this site again.

csSuggestNote.message: Keystead offers to save it once you submit the form.

csSuggestOutdated.message: No suggestion: your generator settings in the popup need a newer Keystead app.

csSuggestUsed.message: Strong password inserted – save it in Keystead after submitting the form.

csTotpCopied.message: 2FA code copied – paste with $KEYS$ (valid for $SECONDS$ s)

csOtpGone.message: No 2FA code available any more – fill the login again.

csDwellOccluded.message: Covered – the page is blocking the Keystead menu

csDwellUnsupported.message: Not possible here – please fill from the Keystead button in the toolbar.

hostMissingText.message: The extension works together with the Keystead app on this computer. To set it up:

hostStep2.message: In Keystead: Settings → Browser integration → click “Enable” next to your browser.

hostStep3.message: Close this window and open it again.

appUnavailableText.message: Start Keystead on this computer, then try again.

appTimeoutText.message: Keystead is not responding right now. Check that the app is running and try again.

pairText.message: Connect the extension to your Keystead app once. You confirm the connection in the app – your data never leaves this computer.

pairWaitingText.message: Check that Keystead shows the same code and click “Connect” there.

pairSuccessText.message: The extension is now connected to Keystead.

pairDeniedText.message: The request was denied in Keystead or has expired.

pairErrorText.message: The connection to Keystead could not be established.

lockedText.message: Enter your master password to unlock Keystead.

lockedTextChoose.message: Choose the vault and enter its master password.

switchText.message: Enter the master password of “$TARGET$”. “$CURRENT$” stays unlocked until then.

wrongPassword.message: Wrong master password. Please try again.

unlockNoVault.message: No vault selected. Unlock the vault you want to use once in the Keystead app – after that it works here too.

noPageLoginsTitle.message: No logins for this page yet

noPageLoginsText.message: Save your login and Keystead will fill it in here automatically.

notWebPageText.message: Keystead fills logins on web pages (http/https). Use “Search” to find all entries.

insecurePage.message: Unencrypted page (http): logins are only filled if they are stored for http as well.

neverSaveActive.message: Save prompts are off for this site.

searchHint.message: Search by name, username or website.

settingTotpCopyHint.message: When you fill a login with 2FA, the app copies the current code. Like passwords, it is cleared from the clipboard after the time set in the app.

settingSuggestHint.message: When you sign up or change a password, Keystead suggests one in the new-password field – with the app's default preset or your own generator settings. It is only kept once you use it.

noFocusedField.message: Click into the password field on the page first.

genSourcePresetHint.message: Set in the Keystead app under Generator.

genSourceOwnHint.message: Only in this browser – also for suggestions on web pages.

genEmptyText.message: Click “Generate” or press Enter. Only what you copy or fill is kept.

genPreviewNote.message: Preview – it is only kept once you copy or fill it.

genStale.message: The options have changed – “Regenerate” applies them.

genCopiedRemembered.message: Copied – kept in the app's generator history

genFailed.message: The app could not generate a password with these settings. Is the Keystead app up to date?

genMinUppercase.message: At least this many uppercase letters

genMinLowercase.message: At least this many lowercase letters

genEntropyHint.message: Estimated randomness of these settings – the more bits, the harder to guess.

genIssueLength.message: The length must be between 4 and 128 characters.

genIssueSeparator.message: The separator can be 8 characters long at most.

genIssueNoCharset.message: Select at least one character group.

genIssueEmptiedUppercase.message: Every uppercase letter is excluded – remove some from “Never use these characters” or turn uppercase letters off.

genIssueEmptiedLowercase.message: Every lowercase letter is excluded – remove some from “Never use these characters” or turn lowercase letters off.

genIssueEmptiedDigits.message: Every digit is excluded – remove some from “Never use these characters” or turn digits off.

genIssueEmptiedSymbols.message: Every symbol is excluded – remove some from “Never use these characters” or turn symbols off.

genIssueMinimums.message: The minimum counts add up to $N$ characters – more than the length of $LENGTH$.

genIssueSymbolsEmpty.message: Enter at least one symbol or turn symbols off.

genIssueSymbolsInvalid.message: Only symbols like ! # $$ % are allowed – no letters, digits, accented characters or spaces.

genIssueStartWithLetter.message: “Start with a letter” needs uppercase or lowercase letters.

genIssueAppOutdated.message: Your Keystead app is too old for “$SETTING$” and would skip it. Update the app or change the setting.

genAppOutdated.message: Your generator settings need a newer Keystead app. Update the app or change the settings.

errorNoFields.message: No login form found on the page. Try reloading the page.

errorInsecure.message: Not filled: unencrypted page (http), but the login is stored for https.

errorNotFound.message: This login doesn't match the page.

extUpdateText.message: This extension was loaded from another folder. The Keystead app keeps it up to date here:

extUpdateHint.message: Switch once: open chrome://extensions → “Load unpacked” → choose this folder. From then on the extension updates with the app.
